title: Delta-neutral BTC/ETH spot-perpetual basis convergence (z-score entries, banded exits, time stops)

mechanism.summary: When the 1h basis (perp close / spot close - 1) deviates from its rolling mean by >= z_entry standard deviations, take a delta-neutral pair toward convergence: positive premium => short perp + long spot; negative premium => long perp + short spot. Exit when |z| <= exit band or a time stop expiries. Funding accrues on the perp leg while held (short premium receives positive funding). One unit of notional per leg, no leverage, 50/50 BTC/ETH slot weights.
mechanism.distinct_from_funding_carry: Entry requires absolute basis dislocation (z-score of the premium), not positive funding. The intended PnL is spread convergence; funding is an incidental accrual. The unconditional-carry benchmark below tests whether this adds anything over passive carry.
mechanism.convergence_speed_evidence: Hourly premium AR(1) is 0.879 (BTC) / 0.876 (ETH), implied half-life 5-6h, BUT dislocations at z>=2 widen over the 48-96h holdings before reverting; the zero-cost diagnostic (trials.json T9) shows negative gross pair PnL over development even with no costs.

data_used: quant-trading/data/raw/binance/spot-1h/{BTCUSDT,ETHUSDT}: 1h kline closes 2020-08..2024-12 (manifest sha e1b760e96ba7d71a70188afdfa171db6ff33621d64f769fe182b37645f70a72d verified at run start)
quant-trading/data/raw/binance/funding-rate/{BTCUSDT,ETHUSDT}: 8h funding events 2020-08..2024-12 (6,573 events each), floored to hour, applied to positions held at the event instant
19 documented missing spot hours (2020-2023) forward-filled (last traded price persists); zero missing perp hours on the 2020-08-01..2024-12-31 hourly grid of 38,736 bars

parameters.selected: L336_zin3_ts96 (highest development net Sharpe among the 8; all 8 were net-negative, selected before touching validation)
parameters.position_sizing: 1x notional per leg, delta-neutral, no leverage

signal_timing.bar: 1h kline with open_time t; bar close at t+1h
signal_timing.signal: z computed from closes through bar close t
signal_timing.execution: decision applied to bar t+1 (next-bar); first entry cost charged at the entry bar; no same-bar signal-use
signal_timing.funding_alignment: a funding event at instant H charges/pays positions held at H (assigned to the bar whose close is H)
signal_timing.leakage_note: z[t-1] decides pos[t]; rolling statistics use only data through t-1

cost_model.application: unit_cost charged at each entry and each exit of the pair (both legs together), turnover counts 2.0 one-way notional units per pair trade
cost_model.stress_note: 2x stress multiplies every cost; validation excess vs carry at 2x is -0.7397 (cumulative), far below zero

benchmark.cash: 0.0 return, no leverage; the pair holds delta-neutral legs plus idle quote margin earning nothing, so cash is the honest floor
benchmark.unconditional_carry: always-short-premium 50/50 BTC+ETH delta-neutral pair (perp short, spot long), identical one-way cost model with a single entry+exit round trip per window (38 bps x multiplier, charged at window start), pure funding receipt
benchmark.why: the amendment's mandatory naive baseline 'unconditional fully funded carry'; a fixed per-window round trip is the cheapest honest financing of the same exposure

development_2020_08_2023_12.note: all 8 predeclared variants net-negative in development (range -10.46 to -30.79 Sharpe)

metrics.all_validation_variants: every one of the 8 predeclared variants is net-negative in validation at 1x and 2x (see trials.json); the falsification does not depend on the selection choice

first_falsification_gate.definition: Family falsified if z-score convergence entries cannot earn positive cumulative validation excess versus unconditional carry after both-leg trading costs; additionally, positive gross (zero-cost) development PnL is required for any cost reduction to be a plausible rescue.
first_falsification_gate.test: validation_net_cum(2x costs) - carry_cum(2x costs) >= 0 AND validation net Sharpe > carry Sharpe
first_falsification_gate.observed: validation excess at 2x = -0.739722 (negative); validation net Sharpe -16.234 << carry 23.998; zero-cost diagnostic shows NEGATIVE gross pair PnL in development (BTC -0.083, ETH -0.180 cumulative) so the loss is structural, not cost-model artefact

leakage_checks: signal shift: position during bar t uses only z from close t-1 (verified in backtest_pair loop)
rolling mean/std use trailing windows ending at the signal bar, no forward window
selection used development net Sharpe only; validation metrics computed after the choice was frozen (trials.json records the predeclared decision)
funding assigned to positions held at the event instant, which a live taker entering next-bar could hold; no lookahead on funding
19 missing spot hours forward-filled (price persistence); no gaps used as zero returns

wave-one horizon enforced in code: run.py exits(3) if --end > 2024-12-31 unless QUANT_HOLDOUT_UNLOCK=1 (verified: locked run rc=3; unlocked run reaches 2025-06-30 only with the env flag); holdout_accessed=false is accurate for every reported number
risks: Cost sensitivity: family failure margin is enormous (excess -43% at 1x, -74% at 2x in 2024), so cheaper execution does not change the verdict
Gross-negative structure: premium dislocations widen over 48-96h before reverting (trend-coupling), so longer-horizon unconditional convergence may also fail; only the predeclared grid was tested

Benchmark choice: unconditional carry earned +12.4% in 2024 with Sharpe 24; funding-only selection would have looked deceptively strong, which is why this z-score family is distinct and was tested separately

Single-validation-window dependence: 2024 had persistently positive funding; a negative-funding year could flip the carry benchmark sign, but the strategy excess is negative in both cost treatments regardless
Model simplifications: no margin-interest on idle cash (conservative for strategy), funding PID at event instant only, no slippage beyond the flat bps assumption
next_experiment: Do not iterate this family within wave one. If revisited after the prospective forward shadow: test convergence at longer horizons (4-24h holding, larger exit bands ~1.0) with an explicit widening-stop, and require positive zero-cost gross PnL over the full development window before any cost analysis; also consider premium-z conditioned on funding sign (only short premium when funding > 0) as the minimal carry-coupled variant, with the trial budget reset.
